name: xtracsyscode
description: XtracsysCode — local-model agent desktop app for macOS. Built-in model requests use loopback servers; shell commands and plugins are not sandboxed.
author: Xtracsys LLC

scripts.dev:electron: npm run build:main && XTRAC_DEV=1 electron dist-electron/electron/main.js
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:web
scripts.test: npm run build:main && node tests/skills.test.mjs && node tests/plugins.test.mjs && node tests/security.test.mjs && node tests/doc-plugins.test.mjs && node tests/release-provider-mcp.test.mjs && node tests/release-plugin-restore.test.mjs && node tests/release-zip.test.mjs
scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip
